Define a coordinated turn in terms of ball position.

summary_questions: Explain how increasing bank angle affects the stall speed of an aircraft.
Describe the control inputs required to maintain a coordinated standard rate turn.
Why must a pilot apply opposite rudder when initiating a turn with ailerons?
